DML.SELECT: SELECT user_id as "userId", role_id as "roleId", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM conf.roles_users WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.roles_users (user_id, role_id, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:userId, :roleId, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM conf.roles_users WHERE user_id = :userId AND role_id = :roleId
